$comment: Platform-wide defaults for every automation. Layer 2 of 5 (after the schema defaults in packages/core). Contains no secrets and no automation-specific values.

browser.$comment_recordVideo: Off by default. A video covers the WHOLE run, which is what makes it good for demonstrating the process end to end and wrong for unattended production - it would film every carrier portal the robot touches. Turn it on per run with RECORD_VIDEO=true.

$comment_mfa: Where MFA codes come from. Manual is the safe default: it needs a TTY, so an unattended run fails fast instead of silently reaching into a mailbox. An environment opts in to a Gmail provider explicitly. gmail holds env-var NAMES only.
